errors.text: The intervention is generic machine learning rather than a machine-learning interatomic potential coupled to free-energy perturbation.
The hypothesis does not specify ab initio-quality sampling of both solid and dense-fluid phases or explain how absolute Gibbs free energies and their crossing would be obtained.
It omits the key physical contributions from electronic excitations and solid-state short-range order.
The cited evidence concerns phase classification and mixing enthalpy trends, not high-temperature free energies, liquid thermodynamics, MTP accuracy, or FEP convergence.
The falsification rule uses an undefined 'significant' deviation and provides no quantitative accuracy or efficiency threshold.
